question: Should OpenClaw add bundled dashboard log-tail and command-output widgets now, and what log/output source, scope, redaction, retention, export, and command-execution boundaries must they follow?
rationale: The feature is product- and security-sensitive, depends on unmerged dashboard substrate work, and current primitives have different authorization and exposure models that automation should not collapse by default.

options.title: Stage After Substrate And Contract
options.body: First settle the dashboard substrate and a narrow read-only log/output contract, then implement these as bundled dashboard widgets with explicit security tests.

options.title: Defer To Roadmap
options.body: Keep the issue as a roadmap item until stream/command-output bindings and dashboard security review are complete.

options.title: Reject Bundled Widgets
options.body: Keep logs and command output in existing Logs/Terminal surfaces and require external plugins or custom widgets for dashboard composition.

recommendation.title: Stage After Substrate And Contract
recommendation.body: First settle the dashboard substrate and a narrow read-only log/output contract, then implement these as bundled dashboard widgets with explicit security tests.

likelyOwner.reason: Their merged history covers both the Control UI plugin-tab seam and terminal output replay primitives that the decision would combine.
